project_name: Tá Na Hora — Multi-Tenant Digital Menu & Online Ordering Platform

responsive.breakpoint: mobile-first (default < 640px for mobile web, md: 768px, lg: 1024px)
responsive.layout: Mobile-first single-column vertical feed with horizontal scrolling category chips and bottom-anchored sticky floating cart bar (z-40). Desktop reflows to responsive multi-column grid for products and persistent side/drawer cart.
responsive.typography: Mobile-first fluid scale. Headings H1 max text-3xl on mobile scaling to text-5xl on desktop. Touch-friendly font sizes for form inputs (min 16px to prevent iOS auto-zoom).
responsive.overflow_guard: Strict overflow-x-hidden on root wrapper. Category chips use touch swipe native overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum touch target size 48x48px for all steppers, chips, status action buttons, and bottom CTAs.

typography.heading_font: Outfit, sans-serif (Google Font - bold, high impact, appetite-appealing geometric curve)
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif (Google Font - crisp legibility for menus, descriptions, prices)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, monospace (for order IDs, monetary totals, and timestamps)

testing_attributes.guideline: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, status badges, cart bar, modals, tabs) MUST include data-testid with kebab-case identifiers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts 'Outfit' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' in public/index.html or index.css.
First demo tenant default: 'Tá Na Hora — Bar e Lanchonete' (Itu-SP, Tue-Sat 11:00-14:30). Provide clear tenant switching or path-based public page '/pedidos-restaurant' or '/tana-hora'.
Implement the two primary views: (1) Public Storefront (Customer) and (2) Admin Panel (Lojista) + Super-Admin panel list of lojistas.
In Public Storefront, ensure the floating cart bar is bottom-anchored on mobile with total item count and price, clicking opens the cart modal/drawer.
In Admin Panel, implement full order status workflow (New -> Accepted -> In preparation -> Ready -> Out for delivery -> Delivered / Cancelled) with distinct status pill colors.
In Products CRUD, support name, description, photo selection/upload, category, size pricing (P/M/G with 'from R$XX' calculation), add-ons, and availability toggle.
Include store customization page for updating logo, cover, name, WhatsApp, address, opening hours, and primary color.
Use sonner for instant feedback on adding items to cart or updating order statuses.
All elements MUST have data-testid attributes for automated testing.
